def test_fresh_independent_cases():
    """Each independent case uses a fresh game instance."""
    game1 = TikTakToe(5, 5, 3)
    game2 = TikTakToe(5, 5, 3)

    # game1: horizontal win
    assert game1.placeFigure(0, 0, X)
    assert game1.placeFigure(1, 0, X)
    assert game1.placeFigure(2, 0, X)
    assert game1.checkForWinner() == X

    # game2: vertical win (independent)
    assert game2.placeFigure(0, 0, O)
    assert game2.placeFigure(0, 1, O)
    assert game2.placeFigure(0, 2, O)
    assert game2.checkForWinner() == O

    # game1 board still has X's, game2 board still has O's
    board1 = game1.getCurrentBoard()
    board2 = game2.getCurrentBoard()
    assert board1[0][0] == X
    assert board2[0][0] == O

# Non-square board tests (7x5, K=3)

def test_rect_horizontal_win(fresh_rect_game):
    game = fresh_rect_game
    # Place X at (0,0), (1,0), (2,0) -> horizontal K=3 win on 7x5 board
    _place(game, 0, 0, X)
    _place(game, 1, 0, X)
    _place(game, 2, 0, X)

    winner = game.checkForWinner()
    assert winner == X

    # Repeated calls are stable
    assert game.checkForWinner() == X
    assert game.checkForWinner() == X

    # Grid unchanged after checkForWinner
    board = _board_copy(game)
    assert board[0][0] == X
    assert board[0][1] == X
    assert board[0][2] == X
    assert board[0][3] == E
    assert board[0][6] == E
